figures.title: Size the worst conducting path
figures.caption: Normalized widths at equal length: reference inverter N = 1, P = 2. Device bodies omitted.
figures.alt: Size the worst conducting path. Match each worst-case path to the chosen reference. Equal resistance is a first estimate, not equal extracted delay.
figures.takeaway: Match each worst-case path to the chosen reference. Equal resistance is a first estimate, not equal extracted delay.

figures.title: A positive-edge flip-flop, built from two static TG latches
figures.caption: Each latch has two inverters and complementary input / feedback transmission gates.
figures.alt: A positive-edge flip-flop, built from two static TG latches. Two inverting latch stages preserve polarity. Complementary clock phases prevent both latches being transparent in the ideal model.
figures.takeaway: Two inverting latch stages preserve polarity. Complementary clock phases prevent both latches being transparent in the ideal model.

figures.title: Setup and hold bracket the same capture edge
figures.caption: Illustrative timing only: tsetup = 40 ps, thold = 20 ps, tCQ = 60 ps. Not a measured cell.
figures.alt: Setup and hold bracket the same capture edge. Setup is before the active clock edge; hold is after it; clock-to-Q is a response delay, not a stability requirement.
figures.takeaway: Setup is before the active clock edge; hold is after it; clock-to-Q is a response delay, not a stability requirement.

figures.title: 6T SRAM: the read must leave the stored bit intact
figures.caption: Shown reading Q = 0, Q̅ = 1. Both bitlines start precharged high; then WL rises.
figures.alt: 6T SRAM: the read must leave the stored bit intact. During a read, precharged BL pushes the stored zero upward through the access transistor. The pull-down must win without making writing impossible.
figures.takeaway: During a read, precharged BL pushes the stored zero upward through the access transistor. The pull-down must win without making writing impossible.

figures.title: A precharged ROM bitline is a current competition
figures.caption: Read-zero convention here means BL discharges. The shown inverter output Y has the opposite polarity.
figures.alt: A precharged ROM bitline is a current competition. The keeper must exceed total off-leakage but lose to one selected cell. After the bitline crosses the detector threshold, feedback removes keeper contention.
figures.takeaway: The keeper must exceed total off-leakage but lose to one selected cell. After the bitline crosses the detector threshold, feedback removes keeper contention.
